structural_breaks.note: Spin-off from Siemens AG and listing; FY2020 and earlier quarters are combined (carve-out) figures printed as comparatives.

revenue_division_legacy only: the Q1 FY2022 release restated the Q1 FY2021 Transmission external-revenue comparative from 1,295 (as printed in the Q1 FY2021 release) to 1,251. Q2–Q4 FY2021 comparatives were unchanged. The FY2021Q1 point keeps the as-reported 1,295, and FY2022Q1 YoY uses the printed comparative 1,251. Grid Technologies and group revenue are not affected.

From FY2023 new segments Gas Services, Grid Technologies, Transformation of Industry, Siemens Gamesa replace Gas and Power + SGRE; FY2022 quarters recast in FY2023 releases (e.g., GT Q1 FY22 revenue 1,323 vs legacy Transmission external revenue 1,298).

Agreement to sell Trench (bushings, instrument transformers, coils; 9 factories, ~2,400 staff) to Triton; closing expected H1 CY2024. Trench-related special items booked in Grid Technologies (Q1 FY24). Not recast.

profile.products: Grid Technologies: power transformers (typically 10–1,300 MVA, 10–800 kV; range delivering well above 1,000 MVA and 1,100 kV), HVDC converter transformers, phase-shifters, wind-turbine (offshore) transformers, distribution transformers (10 kVA–10 MVA per SE product page), GIS/AIS HV switchgear & breakers, HVDC & FACTS systems, grid automation/substation solutions, transformer services.

plants.products: large power transformers; €220m expansion (+~50% capacity by 2028), ~1,000 staff, transformers since 1912
offshore wind-turbine transformers (80% export quota, >70 countries) and compact low-noise power transformers (5,000th unit shipped to New York City 2024)
first SE large power transformer factory in US ($150m; 24→57 LPT units/yr; production start targeted 2026–27)

profile.end_markets: TSOs/utilities (HVDC grid connections, offshore wind), data centers (transformer business growth cited Q3 FY26), industry, renewables integration. US cited as main order-growth driver; Europe and North America main GT demand regions (Q3 FY26 release).
export_routes: AT->US (Weiz power transformers to New York)

European TSO capex/HVDC awards (e.g., TenneT/Amprion annual reports, BNetzA grid development plan) — GT order driver; wishlist

gaps: Grid Technologies history starts FY2022Q1 (recast comparatives in FY2023 releases); no quarterly GT data before that. YoY for GT therefore available FY2023Q1–FY2026Q3 (15 quarters) plus levels FY2022.
Legacy Transmission division external revenue (Gas and Power disaggregation) FY2020Q1–FY2022Q4 is stored separately as revenue_division_legacy; not spliced (different scope/metric).
No quarterly Transmission orders were printed in FY2021–FY2022 releases (only annual/half-year in CMD data books) — orders_segment starts FY2022Q1.
FY2019Q4–FY2020Q3 group revenue exists only as prior-year comparative columns (pre-listing combined financials); no prior_year_comparative for those points.

collection_notes: Source: Siemens Energy Earnings Releases (assets.siemens-energy.com), table "Overview of Segment figures" — first (quarterly) block. Q3 FY2025 release found via SE press page (ER_E_final PDF).
